title: When Wording Steers the Evaluation: Framing Bias in LLM judges

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM judgment consistency by constructing paired evaluation prompts that query the same underlying content but differ in linguistic framing, specifically comparing predicate-positive (P) and predicate-negative (¬P) constructions.

Measuring the proportion of affirmative ('yes') responses across both predicate-positive and predicate-negative prompt framings to quantify the model's overall tendency to agree with the presented statement.
